program.name: Loaded Jumps
program.subject: Plyometrics
program.blurb: Contrast training: a heavy lift, then a jump, so the jump gets more out of the legs.
program.about: Heavy then fast. Each straight set pairs a lift with a jump straight after it, squats then squat jumps one day, deadlifts and swings then broad jumps the next, so the jump gets more from muscles the lift has woken up. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Jump & squat contrast / jump & hinge contrast
